name: Forex Factory weekly calendar export
rate_limits: About 2 downloads per 5 minutes before a Request Denied page (third party report on MQL5, unverified; our first request was once refused).
history_start: Current week only. A community archive on Hugging Face covers 2007 to April 2025.
what_it_has: This week's economic events with title, country, time with time zone, impact level, forecast and previous value, as JSON from nfs.faireconomy.media. There is no actual value field.
simple: A free list of this week's big economic announcements and what experts expect each one to say.
license_terms: Main site blocks our reader (HTTP 403), so terms are unread. Personal research use only, no redistribution.
quality_notes: Only the current week, so we must save a copy every week to build our own history of forecasts. Forecast values can change during the week. The Hugging Face archive warns values may have been edited after the event.

relevance.reason: The only free consensus forecast feed; a weekly snapshot job would build our own surprise history.
